subject: BlueFjord procurement: DPA, SOC2 link, and PO steps
messages:
From: Samantha Lin <samantha@bluefjord.com>

Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@bluefjord.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueFjord vendor intake: DPA & PO path

Hi Evelyn,

We're starting vendor setup for Redwood to get an initial PO in place and confirm data governance items. Procurement asked I send:
- Signed DPA or redline path
- SOC 2 report or a public summary link
- Current subprocessor list
- PO instructions and invoicing contact

Quick context: we're planning a committed pilot (estimated $45k ARR) and need the procurement gate cleared by EOW next Friday if possible. Our legal lead Olivia is looped on the DPA redline timeline.

Can you confirm what you need from our side (format, contact for PO), and whether Redwood prefers DocuSign for DPA?

Thanks,
Samantha Lin
Head of Vendor Ops | BlueFjord Analytics
Attachments: BlueFjord_vendor-intake-form.pdf (application/pdf)
From: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lin <samantha@bluefjord.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@bluefjord.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueFjord vendor intake: DPA & PO path

Hi Samantha — welcome, and thanks for the clear list.

Short answers:
- DPA: we can accept a redline. I'll attach our latest DPA (Redwood_DPA_v2.1.pdf). Preferred flow is DocuSign for execution; we can also e-sign if you need faster internal approvals.
- SOC 2: public summary link below; if you need the full report we can initiate a secure transfer (we'll need an NDA or an approved secure portal).
- Subprocessors: I'll include our current public subprocessor roster; if your procurement needs an exported CSV, let me know.
- PO: our procurement team prefers a PO sent to accounting@redwood.com with the Chase remittance details. I'll paste a one-page PO instruction PDF and the internal contact.

Next steps I propose:
1) Olivia if you have DPA redline comments, please send by Wed 9/16 so Legal can triage.
2) Samantha, share the exact purchase order name and billing address you will use.
3) Ben and David, can you confirm SLA/credits asks for this pilot and whether finance needs a contract number before PO?

I'll attach the files and send a DocuSign envelope once we have Olivia's redline preference.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Vendor Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123
Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v2.1.pdf (application/pdf), SOC2-summary-link.txt (text/plain), BlueFjord_PO_instructions.pdf (application/pdf)
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: BlueFjord vendor intake: DPA & PO path

Eve / David — thanks for the ping. A few commercial notes for the PO:
- Pilot pricing is 3 months of reserved capacity + usage, expect an initial invoice of ~$8k to establish billing and then monthly usage.
- We can accept a PO referencing deal BD-4589.
- SLA credits: standard SLA in SOW; for pilot we can offer a 99.5% availability target and a one-time onboarding credit of $500 if go-live within 30 days.

David, can you confirm accounting@redwood.com and Chase remittance as Evelyn noted? Also confirm if finance needs a signed contract prior to accepting PO (some customers require both).

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks Evelyn — that helps. A couple clarifying items from our side:
1) DPA redline: Olivia will attach comments by EOD Wed 9/16. We prefer DocuSign for execution.
2) SOC2: the public summary is fine for procurement initially; Olivia will request the full report only if legal needs it for SOC2 attestations.
3) Subprocessors: can you confirm whether Redwood's subprocessor list includes any cloud transformation partners (we need to mark any that will handle customer data outside of our region).
4) PO: Billing address is below — please confirm the PO reference (we'll use BD-4589).

BlueFjord billing info:
BlueFjord Analytics, Inc.
Accounts Payable
321 Harbor Way
San Francisco, CA 94105
Attn: AP Team

Appreciate the SLA credit offer, Ben — we'll flag internally.

On a timing note: procurement target is to route PO and DPA by end of week 9/17. Is that still feasible on Redwood's side?

Samantha
From: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lin <samantha@bluefjord.com>

Subject: Re: BlueFjord vendor intake: DPA & PO path

Hi Samantha / Olivia — quick update to close the loop before EOW:

- Olivia's redline was received and our legal gave a small set of comments we flagged inline. Because the changes are limited to a few clauses (data localization carveout and subprocessor notice timing), we can proceed with DocuSign with one negotiation cycle.
- I created a DocuSign envelope for the DPA and included the redline summary: https://app.docusign.com/BlueFjord/Envelope/0a1b2c3d
- SOC2: public summary link provided; if you confirm you need the full report I'll trigger a secure share (we'll need your secure portal details).
- Subprocessors: public roster includes AWS, FastCache Inc., and LogStream (all listed on the roster). FastCache operates some services in eu-west-1; we'll flag that in the roster CSV.
- PO path: please send PO referencing BD-4589 to accounting@redwood.com. Invoices should be sent to invoices@bluefjord.com per your billing address.

Attachments included: Redwood_DPA_v2.1.pdf (attached to email and DocuSign), SOC2-summary-link.txt, BlueFjord_PO_instructions.pdf

If you sign the DocuSign envelope today, Finance will use that to create the contract number and accept the PO. Let me know if you'd like us to pre-fill the PO reference on the envelope.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Vendor Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
